features.name: Filter and Count
features.description: Filters 10,000 integers with a predicate and counts the survivors.

features.name: Project To Array
features.description: Projects 10,000 integers through a selector and materializes a new array.

features.name: Filter, Project, Materialize
features.description: Filters 5,000 orders by amount, projects one property, and materializes a list.

features.name: Chained Pipeline
features.description: Composes a filter, a projection, a second filter, and a limit into one four-stage query.

features.name: List Source
features.description: Runs the canonical filter and projection over a List<int>.

features.name: Opaque Source
features.description: Runs the same query over an IEnumerable<int> exposing no count, indexer, or array.

features.name: Span Source
features.description: Runs the same query over a ReadOnlySpan<int>.

features.name: Paged Slice
features.description: Skips 4,000 integers, takes the next 1,000, and materializes them.

features.name: Any Match
features.description: Reports whether any of 10,000 integers satisfies a predicate first met at index 9,500.

features.name: First Match
features.description: Returns the first of 5,000 orders satisfying a predicate first met at index 4,500.

features.name: Flatten Nested Sequences
features.description: Flattens 500 inner arrays of 20 integers and materializes the result.

features.name: Distinct Values
features.description: Reduces 10,000 integers containing 1,000 distinct values to the distinct set.

features.name: Zip Pairs
features.description: Pairs two sequences of 10,000 integers and materializes the products.

features.name: Aggregate
features.description: Folds 10,000 integers with a caller-supplied accumulator and a seed.

features.name: Ordered Top N
features.description: Orders 5,000 orders by descending amount and materializes the identifiers of the top 20.

features.name: Group and Aggregate
features.description: Groups 5,000 orders by region and produces one summed total per region.

features.name: Join and Project
features.description: Joins 5,000 orders to 500 customers on the customer key and projects the pairs.

features.name: Struct Predicate Filter
features.description: Filters and counts 10,000 integers with a struct-typed predicate instead of a delegate.
features.reason: With this few rated entrants, the reference is a library's own result, not a result earned against a competitor, so the full 200 points would not reflect a win.
